# Breezer

> Breezer is a social snus and nicotine-pouch app for iOS and Android. It logs
> every pouch with one tap, shows consumption, spending and habit statistics,
> connects friends through rankings, squads, an activity feed and a global chat,
> and carries a Quit Mode with a day-by-day quitting journey: the withdrawal
> symptom that eases, the health improvement that follows, and what has been
> saved by then, plus logging for cravings and slips and reminders timed to the
> days attempts usually break.

Breezer is made in Austria. The site is in English, German (Austria) and
Swedish. Download: App Store
(https://apps.apple.com/at/app/breezer/id6737725511) and Google Play
(https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.breezerapp.breezer).

## What it costs

Free to download, and free for everything essential: one-tap logging,
statistics for the current period, profile, friends, rankings, activity feed,
global chat, and Quit Mode with days snus-free, savings and the first four
health improvements. Breezer Pro is an optional subscription at **2.99 € a month
or 19.99 € a year**, each with one free week, once per person. Pro adds the full
quitting journey, all nine health improvements and all six symptom curves, all
24 achievements, premium statistics across earlier periods, the full community
feed, photos in chat, entry to Pro drops and unlimited minigames. Those are the
euro prices from the stores, checked September 2026; outside the euro area the
App Store and Google Play set the local price. Inviting three friends earns 30
days of Pro without paying. Full breakdown: https://breezer.now/pricing

- [Snus Tracker](https://breezer.now/snus-tracker): How the tracker works — one-tap logging, statistics, cost tracking, widgets, tracking without having to quit.
- [Quit Snus](https://breezer.now/quit-snus): Withdrawal timeline, symptoms, what the evidence says helps, the quitting journey, and Breezer's own figures on quit attempts.
- [Zyn Tracker](https://breezer.now/zyn-tracker): Tracking Zyn, Velo and other pouches, reading mg per pouch versus mg/g, daily limits and costs.
- [Pro vs Free](https://breezer.now/pricing): What the free version includes, what Breezer Pro adds, what it costs, and where the free version ends.
- [Breezer vs Snusless](https://breezer.now/vs-snusless): Comparison of the two apps — tracking, quit mode, social features, price.
- [Breezer vs Smoke Free](https://breezer.now/vs-smoke-free): Comparison with Smoke Free, which is built for cigarettes rather than pouches.
- [Blog](https://breezer.now/blog): Sourced articles on nicotine pouches, tracking and quitting.
- [Imprint](https://breezer.now/imprint): Legal notice under Austrian law.

## Articles (English)

- [How Strong Is a Nicotine Pouch, Really?](https://breezer.now/blog/nicotine-pouch-strength): mg per pouch versus mg/g, and how much nicotine actually reaches you.
- [What Nicotine Pouches Actually Do to You](https://breezer.now/blog/nicotine-pouch-side-effects): The documented side effects, and how strong the evidence is for each.
- [What Nicotine Pouches Do to Your Gums](https://breezer.now/blog/nicotine-pouches-gums): Mucosal changes and recession, and what the three existing studies do and do not show.
- [Do Nicotine Pouches Wreck Your Sleep?](https://breezer.now/blog/nicotine-pouches-sleep): Nicotine, sleep architecture and the 3am wake-up.
- [Do Nicotine Pouches Actually Calm You Down?](https://breezer.now/blog/nicotine-pouches-stress): Why the relief feels real, and what happens to anxiety after quitting.
- [Do Nicotine Pouches Help Athletic Performance?](https://breezer.now/blog/nicotine-pouches-sport): The evidence on performance, and the WADA monitoring status.
- [Do Nicotine Pouches Affect Erections, Size and Fertility?](https://breezer.now/blog/nicotine-pouches-erectile-function): The trials that exist on erectile response and sperm counts.
- [Do Nicotine Pouches Help You Quit Smoking?](https://breezer.now/blog/nicotine-pouches-quit-smoking): Pouches as a substitute for cigarettes, and what the reviews found.
- [Cutting Down on Nicotine Pouches, Day by Day](https://breezer.now/blog/taper-nicotine-pouches): A step-down plan, and whether tapering beats stopping outright.

## Notes

- Prices here are the euro prices from the App Store and Google Play, checked
  September 2026. In Sweden and other non-euro markets the stores set the local
  price, so a figure in kronor will differ.
- Health claims on this site name their source, and say when the evidence is
  thin instead of rounding it up. Breezer is an app, not a treatment; articles
  that touch health end by pointing at a doctor or a quitline.
- The community figures on the homepage come from the app itself and are
  recomputed weekly, so they move between deployments.
